text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_details
Description
returns or sets alert details
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_details
[
value
]
ANTIFRAUD::alert_details
Returns alert details
ANTIFRAUD::alert_details value
Set alert details
Valid During
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"original Alert details: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_details]."
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_details
new_value
log
local0.
"new Alert details: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_details]."
}
